description: Channel-projected force at the TCI point: remove K lightest-primary components from the energy-density excitation, measure residual (stress-tensor-ward) force exponent, with strict Ising-control validation.

results.verdict: STAGE_2_REQUIRED: Ising control validates (K in [0, 1, 2], alpha~3.9-4.0) but TCI alpha does NOT reach [3.6,4.4] under exact-diag light-projection (TCI alphas seen: 1.32, 1.32, 1.63, 1.63). At N=16 the dense c=7/10 spectrum mixes channels beyond what local projection separates. The clean test is the chi>=3 multicritical MERA (stage 2), which projects onto scaling operators directly. This is the honest exact-diag ceiling, not a refutation.

notes: Follow-up to SIM-033; isolates the stress-tensor channel by Gram-Schmidt removal of light primaries.
